name: invompt
description: Create invoices from your AI assistant and review them before sending.

interface.longDescription: Create invoices from your AI assistant and review them before sending. Start without creating an account. Create one later and keep all your invoices. Use the same workflow for quotes and estimates; a pro forma is represented as a quote. Reuse saved clients and settings, inspect hosted review links, revise the selected document, export an existing invoice as a PDF, or email the selected document after confirming the recipient. You control every document change and delivery; Invompt does not process payments.
